title: Materiality and detection risk — Corliss Paper
instructions: Compute materiality amounts and acceptable detection risk for three assertions at **Corliss Paper** (private). Pretax income is **$4,000,000**.

exhibits.title: Firm policy
exhibits.content:
Overall materiality: **5%** of pretax income.
Performance materiality: **70%** of overall.
Clearly trivial threshold: **5%** of overall.

exhibits.title: Risk assessment (planned audit risk 5%)
exhibits.content:
| Assertion | Inherent risk | Control risk |
|---|---|---|
| Receivables — existence | 80% | 50% |
| Inventory — valuation | 100% | 100% |
| Cash — existence | 40% | 50% |

parts.prompt: For inventory valuation (lowest detection risk), select the best planned response.

rows.label: Testing at year-end rather than an interim date
rows.explanation: Year-end testing reduces the risk of misstatement in the roll-forward period.

rows.label: Using larger sample sizes
rows.explanation: Lower detection risk calls for more evidence.

rows.label: Relying mainly on inquiry of management
Obtaining independent price data to test NRV
